text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Preeeez!!
Are you watching the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I must see for myself
who becomes this year's Derby Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Hmmmm... Right, the Derby does have that famous saying, after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "‘Becoming the trainer of a Derby Umamusume is harder than becoming Prime Minister’...?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That too, but—
The other one as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Monsters lurk within the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What's this?! King Halo, one of the race favorites!
A complete 180 from her usual style, launching a surprise breakaway from the front!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 2400 meters of Fuchu."
The desire to win that once-in-a-lifetime Derby—
that passion is what throws the gears of Umamusume into disarray.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A dream title I want to seize, even if I have to throw away everything and stake my all on it. That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...How fierce...
At this pace, for the entire 2400m... continuous...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, out of the 18 Umamusume gathered here,
who will claim the title of Japan's best?!
Who will seize their dream—?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
*gasp*... nghhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi! Here comes Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!
The one who raises the victory cry at the Derby is—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaagh!
Aaaaaaargh, aaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Thump)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi! Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!
Crosses the finish liiiiiine in first place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Thump)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has just achieved a truly monumental feat.
Pushing through the crowd—I rush over to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations...!
Congratulations, Tsuru-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waves of joyful cheers rise from the stands as well.
Right now, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi stands at the pinnacle of Japan—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Tr... ain... er...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I'm so... happy. It feels like... a dream.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(What if this really is a dream!
Even though my heart is pounding this hard!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(The world was shaking, burning hot.
My legs, my arms. Everything felt like it was on fire—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...Somehow... it's... prickling...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan!? Tsuru-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—I wonder how many lengths I won by.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
No, no...! Wake up!
Get up, please!! —Tsuru-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Screams from the stands pierce through my back.
In this situation, first... first of all—"
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi!! Get a hold of yourself, Tsuyoshi!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (――With an "absolute" victory, just like the President.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Did I... really do it?)

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ambulance! Call an ambulance!
Where is Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
First, get her outside on a stretcher!
Hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—That person was a beacon of light.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf! She achieves the Triple Crown! Radiantly holding three fingers up to the heavens!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —However, this is not the end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to create it.
A world where every Umamusume can find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the "Emperor" everyone believes in!
I shall prove that hope is boundless!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "The 'Emperor'...! Oooohhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Back then, the President's words were difficult for me. I didn't understand all of it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "So strong... So incredible...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I don't understand it, yet I'm drawn to it.
My chest is aching so intensely with longing.)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Huh. There was a time when Rudolf wasn't the number one favorite?
And she was even injured once—..."

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Ooh... wow...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf wins! Symboli Rudolf stands at the pinnacle of the world!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! The Emperor is absolute!"
"Yeah, there's no way she'd ever lose to anyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehehn!
Rudolf-san winning is an 'absolute guarantee'!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: “—I will, without fail.”

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "—You've gotta get better. You're definitely gonna get strong..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘No, no...! Wake up!
Get up, please!! —Tsuru-chan!!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Tsuyoshi!! Pull yourself together, Tsuyoshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Tsuyoshi!! Hang in there, Tsuyoshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Voice Outside the Room
text_block_list.text:
No way... Tsuyoshi is...――
Trainer-s――... That girl is――!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...The voices of my mother and father.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's voice too. Ah, that's right—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (This is... a hospital room...)

text_block_list.name: Voice Outside the Room
text_block_list.text:
—If it's in the Derby—then—
For that girl, the Kikuka Sho is—...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...It's not your fault, Trainer.
It's not our moms' fault either.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…………
...I wonder how long rehab will take.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I hope it's shorter than last time.
Summer training camp is right around the corner...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“—The upcoming 'Kikuka Sho' will be won by
the 'strongest' Umamusume.”
